speaker: Doctor
text: Since the urinalysis is normal, I need to rule out gynecological causes like pelvic inflammatory disease or ovarian pathology. Have you had any fever, chills, or unusual vaginal discharge, and when was your last menstrual period?

speaker: Doctor
